items.stem: Which two situations typically trigger enhanced due diligence? (Select TWO)

options.text: A customer who is a politically exposed person (PEP)
A customer in a high-risk jurisdiction
A salaried local customer with a simple account
options.rationale: A low-risk profile needs only standard CDD.

options.text: A dormant account with no activity
options.rationale: Dormancy alone is not an EDD trigger.
